doc: Map s17, the Spheda trial floor in a d03 dungeon. Max and Monica find a dead end (event 308), Condor explains the distortion fragment (the Sphere) that must be hit with a stick (event 312), Monica demonstrates Spheda and Max tries a shot-by-shot trial for rewards (items 10, 11 and 363). It contains the full Spheda ball simulation, aim and power gauges, and the story jumps 308, 312 and 317.
